scope: Current project scene and visit history, frozen-member validation, repeated-visit navigation isolation, existing build/observation regressions and three-language coverage.
checks: A→B→A uses distinct visit ownership; returning to the same scene cannot revive an old source link.
Exit-to-enter waiting clears old coordinates and revokes navigation before the next ready frame.
Current child protocols 1, 2 and 3 are checked against frozen members and the backend descriptor.
Historical scene source and current actor source navigation share dialog, task, build, snapshot and visit guards, passed into the editor before asynchronous source writes.
Live author membership cannot rename or redirect frozen visits.
Existing single-scene observations and older entry-only project views remain supported.
Polling and language changes preserve focus/filter without sending execution commands.
git diff --check and product/translation syntax checks passed.
An admitted source read may make the editor busy without revoking itself; busy still blocks initial or duplicate clicks.
During own source loading, visit/dialog changes and dirty/creating drafts revoke the UI guard; independent host source-request/editor-token ownership still blocks superseded writes.
limits: This is a DOM-controller regression run using the real core query functions; actual Chrome layout, runtime processes and ZIP migration are recorded separately.
Counts overlap prior debugging and incremental runs and must not be summed with those logs.
Project control replay, acceptance cases and single-scene authoring tools remain hidden.
